attr.title: Plants Vs Zombies Portable
attr.desc: A fan-made port of the classic tower defense game. You must place plants to defend your house from invading zombies. Requires original game assets from Plants vs. Zombies GOTY edition.
attr.desc_md:
**Features:**
_ Full controller support
- Adventure mode fully playable
- Vasebreaker, Whack a Zombie, and other minigames

Fan port (original game by PopCap/EA)

Original PvZPortable source code: https://github.com/wszqkzqk/PvZ-Portable
attr.inst: Provide the main.pak file and properties/ folder from a legal copy of Plants vs. Zombies GOTY into the pvz_portable folder.
